visual_review.method: every page compared side by side with the source at 60 dpi, with 150-300 dpi close-ups of the cover, the author line and the stamped equation crops on p9, p15, p16, p21, p22; first-line baselines of every Korean block measured against the source text lines on all pages (all within 1.0 pt); edgecheck.py clean after tightening three crops (p10, p16, p23); check.py reports only full-width line-box artefacts of single-line blocks beside stamps, the full-page cover/back-cover stamps and the intentional float wraps on p18/p19, with no visible overlap
